collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — LUCK, OMENS AND LAVASTONES (LO-01 to LO-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A small spider builds a web across a villager's doorway, and some neighbors say it is very lucky.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A small spider has built a web right across the top of (name1)'s doorway. (name1)'s neighbors say that's very lucky: a spider at the door keeps bad things out. Other neighbors say it's just a spider. (name1) has to duck under it every time (he/she) goes in or out.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (name1) leaves it, ducking carefully each time. The web catches dew in the mornings and shines like a little silver net. (name1) starts to look forward to seeing it. Whether it keeps anything out, (he/she) can't say. It certainly keeps the flies out. That's something.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (name1) gently scoops the spider onto a leaf and carries it to a bush by the door, where it can catch flies without being ducked under all day. The spider builds a new web there the next morning. (name1) decides that counts: it's still guarding the door, just from a little further away.
